### NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra — Base Model > Benchmark Results
Source: https://github.com/nvidia-nemo/nemotron/blob/main/usage-cookbook/Nemotron-3-Ultra-Base/README.md
Measured on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 vs GLM-4.5-355B-A32B and Kimi-K2-1026B-A33B, Nemotron 3 Ultra base delivers up to 5x higher TPS at max throughput and leading accuracy for agentic tasks:
| Benchmark | Ultra 550B-A55B | GLM-4.5-355B-A32B | Kimi-K2-1026B-A33B |
| MMLU Pro | 79.0 | 65.6 | 69.3 |
| MMLU | 89.1 | 86.3 | 88.0 |
| Code | 85.3 | 76.2 | 75.3 |
| Math | 85.4 | 72.1 | 79.5 |
| Common Sense | 81.0 | 81.3 | 81.6 |
| Multilingual | 89.0 | 83.3 | 84.2 |
| Peak Throughput | 5x vs GLM | 1x | ~2.5x |

### Nemotron 3 Nano Omni
Source: https://github.com/nvidia-nemo/nemotron/blob/main/README.md
30B total / 3B active A3B MoE; text/image/video/audio; C-RADIOv4-H + Parakeet audio; 3D conv + EVS video; context 16K->49K->262K; best-in-class MMlongbench-Doc, OCRBenchV2; leading WorldSense, DailyOmni, VoiceBench; ~9.2x video-reasoning system capacity, ~7.4x multi-document vs comparable open omni models; license NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License.
